blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: النَّاسُ مَعَادِنُ كَمَعَادِنِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ فَخِيَارُهُمْ فيِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُهُمْ فيِ اْلإِسْلَامِ إِذَا فَقُهُوا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “People are like mines of gold and silver. Those who were the best among them before Islam, if they gain knowledge of the Deen, are also the best after embracing Islam.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- In this hadith, people have been compared to mines. Just as different mines contain different minerals, some containing precious things like gold and silver, and some containing cheap things like lime and coal, in the same way different people have various habits and qualities, and so some are of a high grade and some of a low grade. As long as gold, silver and the like remain in the mine, they have no value. They gain value only after coming out of the mine. Likewise, as long as a person remains hidden in the darkness of Kufr, however much charity and bravery there may be in him, he cannot gain value in the way he gains it by acquiring knowledge of the Deen after embracing Islam.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ غَدَا إِلَي الْمَسْجِدِ لَا يُرِيدُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ خَيْرًا أَوْ يُعَلِّمَهُ كَانَ لَهُ كَأَجْرِ حَاجٍّ تَامّاً حَجَّتَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله موثقون كلهم مجمع الزوائد:١ /١٢٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “The reward received by one who comes to the masjid to learn or to teach what is good is like the reward received by a Hajji who has performed a complete Hajj
